details: Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are pushing Brent crude prices near $91 a barrel, fueling inflation concerns and delaying prospects for central bank rate cuts. This has led to a downturn in major global stock indices, with European markets experiencing declines and bond yields rising. The S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow Jones Industrial Average all ended lower.
title: Middle East Tensions Drive Oil Prices Higher, Weighing on Global Stock Markets

details: Despite a broader downturn in global stock markets, influenced by Middle East tensions and President Trump's denial of Iran talks, the cryptocurrency market displayed a mixed performance. Bitcoin and Ethereum posted modest gains, contributing to a slight increase in overall crypto market capitalization to $2.18 trillion. However, cryptocurrency-related stocks experienced a sell-off, and over $200 million in bullish long positions were liquidated in the last 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum See Modest Gains Amid Geopolitical Stress; Altcoins Mixed
